name: Email alerts
about: Sends an email when a download or a calibration finishes or fails, when a model's engine stops unexpectedly, and when the server starts. Each email names the card or model and what happened, never a path, a prompt or a key; it goes from this PC to your mail server over TLS.

settings.name: host
settings.label: Mail server
settings.help: The SMTP server's DNS name (IONOS: smtp.ionos.com, or your account's regional host).

settings.name: security
settings.label: Security
settings.help: ssl: TLS from the first byte; starttls: STARTTLS before the login. Never plain text.

settings.name: username
settings.label: User name
settings.help: The login (IONOS: the full mailbox address).

settings.name: from
settings.label: From
settings.help: The sender address (IONOS: the mailbox you log in to).

settings.name: password
settings.label: Password
settings.help: The mailbox's password: kept protected in this PC's secret folder, never shown again.
